articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin falls back to $59,000 as Strategy's common and preferred stocks tumble
articles.snippet: Trading firm Wintermute's options desk puts bitcoin in a $61,242 to $63,563 range for Tuesday, with correlation rising across tokens and no fresh ETF bid in sight.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops toward $62,000 as the chip selloff deepens for a second day
articles.snippet: A renewed rout in semiconductor stocks pulled risk assets lower again, and crypto kept sliding. Bitcoin is down 5% on the week, with ether and the memecoins falling harder.

articles.title: Bitcoin crash to $60K opens new $530M demand zone: Will bulls buy in?
articles.snippet: A $525 million Bitcoin buy wall intersects with a major liquidation zone, creating a key battleground between $60,500 and $65,000.

articles.title: Binance withdraws Greece-filed MiCA application
articles.snippet: Binance said it plans to seek authorization in another EU jurisdiction just days ahead of the July 1 MiCA deadline, as unlicensed crypto firms are expected to wind down activities in the bloc.

articles.title: OpenPayd secures MiCA license as stablecoin adoption grows in Europe
articles.snippet: OpenPayd, which provides infrastructure to companies including Kraken crypto exchange, can now offer regulated crypto services across Europe under MiCA.
